name: Novotel Bali Ngurah Rai Airport
address: Jalan Raya Ngurah Rai, Tuban, 80362 Kuta, Indonesia
description: Novotel Bali Ngurah Rai Airport is conveniently located in Bali Denpasar International Airport with direct access to the international departure and domestic arrival sections. Featuring an outdoor pool, the hotel is set in Kuta, 0.8 mi from Tuban Beach and 1.2 mi from Waterbom Bali. Free WiFi can be accessed throughout the property and the front desk is available 24 hours to assist guests. The rooms at Novotel Bali Ngurah Rai Airport are equipped with air conditioning, a flat-screen TV and a safety deposit box. Some rooms come with sofa bed and work area. The private bathrooms have shower and free amenities. For extra comfort, slippers and bathrobes are provided. Guests can work out at the fitness or enjoy a massage at the spa. Laundry services can be requested with additional charges. The hotel also have meeting rooms and a function hall for gatherings. Discovery Shopping Mall is 1.2 mi from Novotel Bali Ngurah Rai Airport , while the famous Uluwatu Temple is 14 mi away from the hotel.
